definitions.short: a pedigree or family list (as growing spontaneously)
definitions.full: H3188. yachas יַ֫חַשׁ noun [masculine] genealogy (Late Hebrew יִחוּס יַחַס Aramaic יִחוּס ) — הַיַּ֫חַשׂ סֵפֶר Neh 7:5 book of Genealogy.

occurrences.englishText: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:
